versions.content: The TcpIp TCP - layer shall map received TCP datagrams to sockets based on the destination port as contained in t he TCP protocol header and the local address (TcpIpAddrId). The local address (TcpIpAddrId) matches if ANY of the following conditions is fu l filled: a) The socket is bound to a unicast local address (TcpIpAddrId) b) The socket local address uses the wildcard “AN Y” AND the socket EthIfCtrl is identical to the EthIfCtrl used in the local address (TcpIpAddrId) c) The socket is bound to TCPIP_LOCALADDRID_ANY
